advisories: Heading-suffix stripping removes only the trailing parenthesised group, so a heading that carried a non-suffix paren group (## Rule (a) (date, reason)) would keep (a) in its match text. No such heading exists in the data; only a problem if one ever does.

HTML comments are stripped with a non-greedy <!--.*?--> match: an unterminated <!-- in CLAUDE.md is not stripped, so a cited name inside it would still count. Accepted: an unterminated comment is already malformed Markdown.

The four pre-existing UNFILLED gaps in .claude/agents/*.md keep check . and test_jumpstarter_passes_its_own_check red on this worktree. Recorded and decided in .qo/plan.md (no-edit rule for .claude/, no test weakening); nothing in this diff is red.
summary: Sceptical review of git diff. tools/jumpstart.py: two constants, two helpers plus a comment-stripper, one audit function, one wiring line in cmd_check, docstring and CLI-help updates - all matching .qo/plan.md, stdlib-only, Python 3.9-compatible (list[str] under the existing __future__ annotations import). All printed strings are ASCII and the pre-existing ASCII test still passes. Docs reconciled per the workflow: CHANGELOG inventory + dated entry, checkpoint block refreshed + dated entry, new INTERNALS entry behind the new rule.
